# Arlington Junk

> Junk removal in Arlington, VA and surrounding Northern Virginia. Fast, friendly service with upfront pricing and same-week pickup in most cases.
> Official site: https://arlingtonjunk.world/

## Contact

- Phone/text: (571) 516-6949
- Email: arlingtonjunkmaster@pm.me
- Web: https://arlingtonjunk.world/
- X: https://x.com/ArlingtonJunk

## Business profile

- Name: Arlington Junk
- Type: Junk removal and hauling
- Base: Arlington, VA
- Service area: Arlington County, VA; Fairfax County, VA; Loudoun County, VA; Alexandria, VA; Washington, DC; Potomac, MD
- Hours: 24/7 bookings
- Pickup timing: Same-week in most cases

## Services

- Furniture removal
- Mattress removal
- Garage and basement cleanouts
- Yard debris removal
- E-waste and appliance removal
- Move-out cleanouts

## Pricing

- Single items: from $99
- Full loads/cleanouts: quoted based on volume
- Upfront price before loading begins

## Process

1. Send a photo of the items or pile.
2. Receive an upfront price.
3. We load, sweep, and haul away, donating or recycling what we can.

## Policies

- We do most lifting, loading, and sweeping.
- Hazardous items like paint, chemicals, fuel, and asbestos are not accepted.
- We donate or recycle what we can.
